subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should `agents_list` expose operator-authored descriptions for agents already visible to the requester?
rationale: The config metadata is already shipped, but propagating it into model-visible discovery is an intentional product and trust-boundary choice.

options.title: Expose bounded descriptions
options.body: Return trimmed, size-bounded descriptions only after current visibility checks and document their operator-authored trust level.

options.title: Keep descriptions config-only
options.body: Preserve the shipped metadata for human and config tooling while omitting it from model-facing discovery.

options.title: Design typed capabilities
options.body: Defer model-visible exposure and replace free-form descriptions with a structured capability contract.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded descriptions
recommendation.body: Return trimmed, size-bounded descriptions only after current visibility checks and document their operator-authored trust level.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history most strongly connects this person to both the original discovery tool and its multi-agent configuration contract.
